info.title: Synq app API
info.description: One backend for the iOS app, web hub and channel bots. Money is integer base units in decimal strings; times are UTC ISO-8601. Login never approves payments.

get.summary: Contract version and which routes this server implements.

post.summary: Exchange a signed native login challenge for a device session.
post.x-synq-roles: wallet that signed the /v2 login challenge

post.summary: Exchange a one-time web sign-in code for a device session (no wallet on the phone).
post.x-synq-roles: holder of a fresh one-time code from a signed-in web session

post.summary: Rotate tokens. Reusing an old refresh token revokes the session.
post.x-synq-roles: holder of the current refresh token for that device

post.summary: End every session of this principal, including this one.

get.summary: Personal context plus one context per business workspace.
Own wallets, personal vaults, circles and recent activity.
Group circles the principal is a verified member of.
Members, attributed contributions, proposals and rules.
Balances, receivables, payables, leads, approvals, agent highlights.
Lead summary, consented transcript and offer versions.

post.x-synq-roles: OWNER, ADMIN (only while handling is HUMAN)

post.summary: Take over, hand back, freeze offers or escalate; 409 on a stale version.
Single-use private invitation link for a prospect.
Bind a private session to the redeeming identity, once.
post.x-synq-roles: external lead with a provider-verified identity

post.summary: Run the deterministic commercial policy checks on one offer version.
Send an offer (or a new version of one) after the policy checks pass.
post.x-synq-roles: OWNER, ADMIN (only while handling is HUMAN)

post.summary: Propose the next policy version; an owner signs it from the approvals inbox.

get.summary: Typed events and chain receipts of one run.
Agent leases with on-chain remaining limits.

post.summary: Prepare a revoke for the issuer to sign; not revoked until on chain.

get.summary: Requests waiting for this wallet's signature, across workspaces.

post.summary: Submit a wallet signature; the server verifies the signer.
Register or update an APNs token and preferences.

get.summary: Server-sent StreamEvent records; replay from a cursor.
get.x-synq-roles: principal; events filtered to their contexts
